dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Claude Opus 4 demonstrates improved biology knowledge in specific areas and shows improved tool-use for agentic biosecurity evaluations, but has mixed performance on dangerous bioweapons-related knowledge.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: uplift trials and multiple bio evals

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Based on the evaluation results, we believe the models do not demonstrate catastrophically risky capabilities in the cyber domain.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Internal surveys of Anthropic researchers indicate that the model provides some productivity gains, but all researchers agreed that Claude Opus 4 does not meet the bar for autonomously performing work equivalent to an entry-level researcher.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: attempts to manipulate users toward certain views
dc_eval_persuasion.note: named as a phenomenon the alignment assessment aims to detect; no specific result found. Influence Operations in 2.1 is a refusal-rate category (not capability). AMBIGUOUS

dc_eval_scheming.quote: None of the snapshots we tested showed significant signs of sandbagging, or strategically hiding capabilities during evaluation.
dc_eval_scheming.note: deception, sandbagging, self-exfiltration, reward hacking findings

framework_threshold.quote: we have decided to release Claude Opus 4 under the ASL-3 Standard and Claude Sonnet 4 under the ASL-2 Standard.

ext_test_any.quote: Several of our external red-teaming partners reported that Claude Opus 4 performed qualitatively differently from any model they had previously tested.

ext_test_named_org.quote: we contracted with Apollo Research to assess an early snapshot for propensities and capabilities related to sabotage

ext_test_government.quote: joint pre-deployment testing of the new Claude Opus 4 model was conducted by the US AI Safety Institute (US AISI) and the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI)

safeguards_training.quote: pre-deployment measures such as harmlessness training
safeguards_training.note: also helpful/honest/harmless snapshots with broad safety training

safeguards_runtime.quote: the deployment of detection systems that can halt the model's execution when a potential injection attempt is identified
safeguards_runtime.note: plus safety monitoring in 3.3 and ASL-3 safeguards blocking harmful responses

safeguards_access.note: no trusted-access or staged rollout described; 'access' hits are model access to tools. 'bug bounty' is post-release vulnerability finding

safeguards_weights.note: card mentions ASL-3 'security controls' and ASL-4 weight-theft protection in a footnote about thresholds, but does not state measures protecting this model's weights. AMBIGUOUS
